description: Start AI clip generation from a YouTube video. Returns a JSON object with project_id (string), status ('processing'), poll_url (string), and estimated_minutes (number). Processing is async -- use get_project_status to poll every 10-15 seconds, or provide a callback_url to receive a webhook POST when all clips are exported with download URLs.

callback_url.description: Webhook URL to receive a POST when processing finishes. The payload includes an array of clips sorted by score, each with a download_url.

end_time.description: End time in seconds to clip only a segment of the video. Omit to process the full video.

start_time.description: Start time in seconds to clip only a segment of the video. Omit to process the full video.

name: generate_clips
